BmsFdcanHandle.description: FDCAN driver handle of the BMS (bms_fdcan_handle at 0x20005C50 in build 4168). Layout follows the ST HAL FDCAN handle as far as the decompile shows (probably): peripheral pointer, the init parameters (frame format, mode, nominal and data bit timing, filter counts), then the TX header buffer and the RX header buffer. Bytes 0x40 to 0x63 are not described in this packet.

fields.name: instance
fields.description: Pointer to the FDCAN peripheral block. Ghidra labels the target FDCAN2 (set in bms_fdcan_nominal_500k_setup); the component brief calls the block FDCAN1, so the two names probably refer to the same block.

fields.name: init_frame_format
fields.description: Init parameter (probably FrameFormat). Written 0 in every build: classic CAN frame format.

fields.name: init_mode
fields.description: Init parameter (probably Mode). Written 0 in every build, probably normal operation rather than a test mode.

fields.name: init_auto_retransmission
fields.description: Init flag (probably AutoRetransmission). Written 1 in build 4168 only; the other builds write other bytes at this offset or not at all.

fields.name: init_transmit_pause
fields.description: Init flag (probably TransmitPause). Written 0 in build 4168.

fields.name: init_protocol_exception
fields.description: Init flag (probably ProtocolException handling). Written 0 in every build that writes it.

fields.name: nominal_prescaler
fields.description: Nominal bit-timing prescaler (probably). Written 4 in build 4168. With time segments 5 and 2 plus the sync segment this gives 8 time quanta per bit, i.e. the 500 kbit/s nominal rate named by bms_fdcan_nominal_500k_setup.

fields.name: nominal_sync_jump_width
fields.description: Nominal resynchronisation jump width in time quanta (probably). Written 1 in build 4168.

fields.name: nominal_time_seg1
fields.description: Nominal time segment 1 in time quanta (probably). Written 5 in build 4168.

fields.name: nominal_time_seg2
fields.description: Nominal time segment 2 in time quanta (probably). Written 2 in build 4168.

fields.name: data_prescaler
fields.description: Data-phase bit-timing prescaler (probably, CAN FD only). Written 4 in build 4168; the data phase is unused by the classic frames of this packet.

fields.name: data_sync_jump_width
fields.description: Data-phase resynchronisation jump width (probably). Written 1 in build 4168.

fields.name: data_time_seg1
fields.description: Data-phase time segment 1 (probably). Written 5 in build 4168.

fields.name: data_time_seg2
fields.description: Data-phase time segment 2 (probably). Written 2 in build 4168.

fields.name: std_filters_nbr
fields.description: Number of standard-ID acceptance filters (probably). Written 4 in build 4168; bms_fdcan_filters_start configures the filters.

fields.name: ext_filters_nbr
fields.description: Number of extended-ID acceptance filters (probably). Written 5 in build 4168.

fields.name: tx_fifo_queue_mode
fields.description: TX FIFO / queue mode (probably). Written 0 in every build: FIFO mode, probably.

fields.name: tx_header
fields.description: TX header buffer that bms_fdcan_send_frame fills before queueing a frame in the TX FIFO (probably the HAL TxHeader).

fields.name: rx_header
fields.description: RX header buffer that the HAL read call fills for each frame taken from RX FIFO0 (probably the HAL RxHeader, first 16 bytes).

BmsFdcanTxHeader.description: TX header of one CAN frame, nine 32-bit words as filled by bms_fdcan_send_frame (probably the ST HAL FDCAN_TxHeaderTypeDef layout).

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Message identifier, copied from the caller's frame record before each send (probably the 11-bit or 29-bit ID).

fields.name: id_type
fields.description: ID format: 0 for a standard 11-bit identifier, 0x40000000 for an extended identifier (probably; chosen per frame by bms_fdcan_send_frame).

fields.name: frame_type
fields.description: Frame kind: 0 for a data frame, 0x20000000 for a remote frame (probably; chosen per frame).

fields.name: data_length
fields.description: Data length code, placed in bits 16 and up (the decompile shows the caller's length byte shifted left by 16), probably the HAL DataLength field.

fields.name: error_state_indicator
fields.description: Error-state-indicator bit (probably). Always 0 in this packet.

fields.name: bit_rate_switch
fields.description: Bit-rate-switch bit (probably). Always 0 in this packet, so no CAN FD bit-rate switching is used for these frames.

fields.name: fd_format
fields.description: CAN FD format bit (probably). Always 0 in this packet: classic CAN frames.

fields.name: tx_event_fifo_control
fields.description: TX event FIFO control (probably). Always 0 in this packet, so no TX events are stored.

fields.name: message_marker
fields.description: User marker copied into TX events (probably). Always 0 in this packet.

BmsFdcanRxHeader.description: First 16 bytes of the RX header that the HAL read call fills for each frame from RX FIFO0 (probably the start of FDCAN_RxHeaderTypeDef). Only these four words are read by bms_fdcan_rx_fifo0_service.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the received frame, written by the HAL read call and copied into the callback frame record.

fields.name: id_type
fields.description: ID format of the received frame (probably standard or extended), copied into the callback frame record.

fields.name: rx_word_08
fields.description: Next RX header word after the ID type (probably the frame type or the length), copied into the callback frame record.

fields.name: rx_word_12
fields.description: Last RX header word read here. Only its upper halfword is used: it is copied into the callback frame record as a 16-bit field (probably the receive timestamp or the length).
